text:
Sana: Quick sync — ACME wants a short trial. They asked for an air-gapped/policy-controlled eval running in their VPC, sample dataset (~5k docs), automated redaction, and a committed pricing ask for a 3-month pilot. Are there any immediate blockers from infra/security?

Tyler: Re: connectivity — we can support VPC peering or customer-VPN. For air-gapped on-prem we do a private bundle but that needs extra procurement. For their VPC option we need: 1) list of egress IPs 2) ports for our health checks (443 + 9000 for metrics) 3) IAM role or short-lived creds for S3.

Eva: Success criteria from customer side: 
- 10k queries/day sustained for 48h
- latency p95 <= 300ms for short prompts
- quality: >85% pass rate on their prompt eval set (we need their prompt list)
- redaction: PII removed from sample with <0.1% false negatives in redaction test

Mike: Security checklist: SOC2 + encryption-in-transit + KMS integration required. We should ask ACME for an IP allowlist and SAML SSO details for the console. Also confirm whether they need an HSM-backed KMS.

Sana: They said they'll provide prompt examples this afternoon and can pull a 5k doc sample but need guidance on redaction. Any standard scrub scripts we can share?

Mike: Sharing a quick scrub example (Python) — they can run before upload:
```python
import re
PII_PAT = re.compile(r"(\b\d{3}[-.]?\d{2}[-.]?\d{4}\b)|([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})")
def scrub(text):
    return PII_PAT.sub("[REDACTED]", text)
```
Note: this is basic; recommend we run our redaction evaluator too.

Tyler: Operational notes: provisioning an isolated trial cluster in their VPC takes ~3 business days once we get network details and an IAM role. If they want an on-prem airgap bundle, that's ~2-3 weeks (legal + packaging).

Eva: For the eval harness, we should request: prompt file (CSV), expected outputs or rubric, and a small set of edge-case prompts (10–20) to validate hallucination/regression. Also specify measurement windows.

Sana: Pricing question — ACME asked if we can do a short-term committed discount for 3 months at 30% off hosted list if they commit to X tokens. Is that something we can offer for a pilot?

Tyler: We can do a pilot credit + committed consumption discount, but we need commercial signoff. I'll flag to finance. We typically do a capped pilot discount with a usage floor.

Mike: One enterprise blocker I've seen: they want the ability to rotate KMS keys monthly. We support CMK rotation but if they need automatic monthly rotation with HSM audit logs we need to confirm HSM support in their region.

infra-bot: sandbox-provisioner: queued -> Creating VPC-peered test cluster (request id: pr-8421). ETA: 72 hours for initial cluster once credentials are provided.

Sana: Next steps agreed:
- ACME to send prompt CSV + 5k sample (Sana) — deadline: EOD tomorrow
- Mike to share redaction doc + run a quick sample redaction once they upload
- Tyler to collect network details (egress IPs, IAM role) and escalate pricing to finance
- I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed 10am PT with ACME + SEs

Tyler: Marking action: I'll post a minimal network checklist here in thread.

Eva: I'll draft the success criteria doc and share as a quick Google doc.

Sana: Perfect. If any security/legal blockers come up ping me and I'll loop in account exec. :thumbsup:

Mike: FYI — link to internal redaction eval runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redaction-eval (ACME won't see this link, SEs only)

Sana: Thanks team — keeping this thread for updates.
